contextual_glosses.applicability: Başındaki ses düşmüş biçimin yağ ölçümündeki özel değeri açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağ bağlamını, ağırlık ölçüsü olmasını ve yedi temel birime eşit değeri korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yağ için yedi temel birimlik ağırlık ölçüsü

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölçü adının birden fazla çoğul söylenişi bulunduğu açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Söz konusu biçimlerin aynı ağırlık ölçüsü adının çoğulları olmasını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu adlandırılmış ağırlık ölçüsü ve onun biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; genel tartma eylemine, her türlü miktara veya modern bir ölçü adına genişletilmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı bilinen bir ağırlık ölçüsü olarak doğrular, ancak tek ve değişmez bir nicelik vermez. Bir kullanım kırk gümüş para ağırlığını, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimini gösterir; tanım bu bağlam farkını açıkça korumalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kırk gümüş para ağırlığına eşit bilinen ölçü
yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit ölçü
bu ağırlık ölçüsü adının çoğul biçimleri

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki sözcük biçimine bağlı farklı ölçü değerlerini ve çoğul biçimleri ayırır; bunlardan genel bir kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; yayımlananlar genel ağırlık, küçük para ölçüsü, başka geleneksel birim, hacim-miktar ölçüsü ve ayar standardı sınırlarını gösterir. Artış ve çok büyük tahıl ölçüsü daha uzaktır; öteki kök içi dallar anlamsal olarak ayrıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal değerleri ve sözcük biçimleri belirlenmiş tek bir geleneksel ölçüyü adlandırır; komşu dal ağırlık ve tartma alanının genel kavramıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağlama göre kırk gümüş para veya yedi temel birim değerini taşıyan belirli bir ölçü adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel ağırlık ölçüsü ile genel tartma
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağırlık, tartı aracı ve bir şeye ağırlığını verme gibi genel ölçme alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirlenmiş ağırlık ve ölçme düşüncesinde buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ölçülerin adları ve değerleri ayrıdır: bu dal kırk paralık değeri ve yağdaki değişkeyi taşırken komşu dal çoğunlukla beş paralık küçük miktarı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Para hesabında kırk gümüş para ağırlığına veya yağda yedi birime bağlanan ölçüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kırk paralık ölçü ile beş paralık ölçü
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Altın veya gümüş için kullanılan, çoğunlukla beş gümüş para ağırlığıyla açıklanan daha küçük ölçüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da değerli maden veya para üzerinden açıklanan geleneksel ağırlık ölçüleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın ölçü adı ve verilen değerleri kendine özgüdür; komşu dal başka birim adını ve ağırlığın yanında hacim kullanımını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki sözcük biçimi ve iki bağlamsal değeri bulunan belirli bir ağırlık ölçüsüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka bir adla anılan, hem ağırlık hem hacim ölçüsü olabilen ayrı bir geleneksel birimdir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirli adları, tekil ve çoğul biçimleri bulunan geleneksel ölçü birimleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ağırlığa ve belirli değerlere bağlıdır; komşu dal hacim ile para miktarı arasında daha geniş bir ölçüm alanına yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öncelikle ağırlık ölçüsüdür ve iki özel sayısal değere bağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ağırlık ölçüsü ile hacim ve miktar ölçüsü
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hacim ölçüsünü, yarım başka bir hacim ölçüsünü ve para miktarını birlikte kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sayılabilir veya ölçülebilir bir miktarı geleneksel birimle belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ölçülen miktarı bildiren birimdir; komşu dal ise ölçü araçlarının ve paraların doğruluğunu belirleyen ayar standardıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kendi adı, biçimleri ve geleneksel değerleri bulunan ölçü birimini tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ölçekleri ve paraları denetlemeye yarayan ayarı veya ölçünleme işlemini tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğru ağırlık ve ölçü değerinin belirlenmesi alanındadır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأوقية في الحديث أربعون درهما (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الوقية وزن من أوزان الدهن وهي سبعة مثاقيل (tahdhib)؛ اللغة الجيدة أوقية وجمعها أواقي وأواق (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, aynı ölçü ailesinde bağlama ve sözcük biçimine göre iki değer aktarır: para hesabında kırk gümüş para ağırlığı ve yağ hesabında yedi temel ağırlık birimi. Başlangıç sesini taşıyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir; ölçü adının iki çoğul biçimi de verilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأوقية والأواقي بوصفها وزنا معلوما للدراهم أو الدهن
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الوقاية ولا التقوى ولا الواقي بمعنى الصرد

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuş türünün Türkçedeki doğal adı olarak dalın adlandırma çekirdeğini doğrudan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynakta adlandırılan kuş türünün kimliğini herhangi bir ek anlam yüklemeden korur.

concept_map.definition: Örümcek kuşunun, biri son sesi koruyan diğeri bu sesi düşüren iki biçimde söylenen adı. Adlandırma, kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmamasıyla açıklanır.

facets.statement: Sözcük, örümcek kuşunu adlandıran özel bir kuş adıdır.
Kuş adı, son sesi bulunan daha uzun ve bu sesin düştüğü daha kısa iki biçimde kullanılır.
Adın kuşa verilmesi, yürürken adımlarını fazla açmayan kısa adımlı yürüyüşüyle açıklanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş adının yürüyüş biçimiyle ilişkilendirilen açıklaması da bağlamda görünür kılınmak istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuş türünü ve adlandırmaya gerekçe gösterilen kısa adımlı yürüyüş özelliğini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca örümcek kuşunun bu iki adına ve adlandırma açıklamasına aittir; koruyan kişi, topallayan at veya yara açmayan eyer anlamlarına geçmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı doğrudan örümcek kuşunun adı olarak verir, adın son sesi bulunan ve düşmüş iki biçimini kaydeder ve adlandırmayı kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmamasına bağlar. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırı doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: örümcek kuşu; aynı kuş adının uzun ve kısalmış biçimleri

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kuşa verilmiş iki özel ad biçimiyle sınırlı tutulur ve bunlardan genel bir koruma ya da yürüme anlamı türetilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan dört karşılaştırma kuş adları arasındaki tür ayrımını yeterince gösterir. Öteki kuş adayları da yalnızca aynı alanı paylaşır; kurt adı ile koruma, ağırlık ve hayvan yürüyüşü dalları farklı kimliklerdir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnızca kuş adı olmalarıdır; bu dal örümcek kuşunu, komşu dal ise ibibiği adlandırır ve türler birbirinin yerine geçmez.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örümcek kuşunu ve onun kısa adımlı yürüyüşüne bağlanan adını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İbibik kuşunu ve o kuşa ait ad biçimlerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirli bir kuş türünü doğrudan adlandıran sözleri içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal örümcek kuşunun adıdır; komşu dal tarla kuşunun adıdır. Aynı üst alanda bulunsalar da tür kimlikleri ayrıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısa adımlı yürüyüşüyle açıklanan örümcek kuşu adı merkezde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarla kuşunu ve ona ait farklı ad biçimlerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da küçük kuş türlerine verilmiş adları ve bu adların biçimlerini ele alır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlamsal ortaklık kuş kategorisiyle sınırlıdır; dallar büyüklük, yapı ve tür bakımından bütünüyle farklı kuşları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örümcek kuşunun özel adını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çok daha büyük ve uçamayan deve kuşunun tür adını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kuş türünün doğrudan adı olarak kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın göndergesi örümcek kuşudur; komşu dal başka bir küçük kuş türünü adlandırır ve ortak kuş alanı tür özdeşliği oluşturmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örümcek kuşunu adlandırır ve adını kuşun yürüyüşüyle ilişkilendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: örümcek kuşu ile bir serçe türü
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Serçelere benzeyen başka bir küçük kuş türünün adını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da küçük kuşlardan birine verilmiş sözlü adları taşır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الواقي الصرد (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الواق بكسر القاف بلا ياء (sihah)؛ قيل للصرد واق لأنه لا ينبسط في مشيه (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı bu sözcüğü örümcek kuşunun adı olarak tanımlar ve son sesi bulunan biçimin yanında o sesin düştüğü kısa biçimi de kaydeder. Adın nedeni, kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmaması olarak açıklanır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الواقي والواق اسما للصرد
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الواقي بمعنى الدافع ولا الفرس الواقي ولا السرج الواقي

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde, zarar ile korunacak taraf arasına koruyucu bir unsur koyma fikri vardır; bu fikir kişinin kendisini korkulan veya yanlış davranıştan sakınmasına ve hayvanın ağrılı adımını gözeten bazı kullanımlara uzanır. Belirli ağırlık ölçüsü ile örümcek kuşu adı ise bu koruma çekirdeğinden ayrışmış adlandırma dallarıdır.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

baseline.text: İbrahim'i de an. Hani halkına, "Allah'a kulluk edin ve O'na karşı gelmekten sakının. Eğer biliyorsanız bu sizin için daha iyidir" demişti.

findings.text: Allah'a kulluk ile O'na karşı gelmekten sakınma birlikte, etkisiz koruyuculara karşı kişinin kendisini gerçek koruyucu yetkinin ardına yerleştirmesidir.
“Daha iyi” olan, yalnız öğüt olarak değil, koruma ve rızık yükünü gerçekten taşıyabilen yetkiyi bilgiyle seçme olarak okunur.

activation_trace.role: Supplies obedient worship with submission as the allegiance pole of the paired command.
Supplies the reflexive act of placing oneself in protection as the command's guarded posture.
Makes the resulting arrangement beneficial and salutary for its human recipients.

changed_reading.after: A coupled program of exclusive allegiance and self-protection presented as the addressees' own good.
changed_reading.before: A generic instruction to worship and fear God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives at focus words 5-7 and the comparative at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Humbled obedience is paired with putting oneself behind a guard; the deictic gathers both acts into one beneficial arrangement for the addressees.

activation_trace.role: Makes the intervention an externally voiced and socially audible saying.
Locates the addressees as Abraham's associated human collective.
Identifies humbled obedience as the shared orientation being redirected.

changed_reading.after: Abraham publicly bids his people to reorganize their collective allegiance.
changed_reading.before: Abraham gives individuals a devotional instruction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The voiced saying at word 3 is directed to a named people at word 4 before the worship imperative at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered declaration enters a concrete collective and asks that collective to redirect its shared obedience; the scene is public realignment rather than private counsel.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the beneficial side of the comparison rather than an unqualified command alone.
Makes apprehension of that benefit the explicit epistemic threshold.

changed_reading.after: Their superiority is posed as a truth whose force depends on the hearers actually recognizing it.
changed_reading.before: The commands are simply declared better.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparative at word 9 is followed by the conditional knowing construction at words 11-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The benefit is asserted, but its uptake is conditioned on disclosure to the addressees; superiority is real in the saying yet must become recognizable to them.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in Abraham's publicly emitted words.
Contributes the assay of a person or material as the surah's frame for disclosed allegiance.
Materializes the pressure on Abraham's declaration as an explicit fire threat.
Completes the assay by separation and deliverance from the threatened destruction.

changed_reading.after: His saying places communal allegiance into an assay whose coercive response reveals what each side serves.
changed_reading.before: Abraham's saying communicates a correct proposition to his people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places verbal professions in an assay and later lets Abraham's voiced summons draw a threat of burning followed by rescue. His saying therefore functions as an event that exposes the quality of allegiance under pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the assay frame and the later threat-rescue sequence; I infer that Abraham's speech initiates a disclosure event. A live alternative is that the testing frame describes believers generally and only parallels, rather than governs, his scene.
structural_cues: 29:2-3 place spoken belief under testing that differentiates truthful from false allegiance.
29:24 records the people's answer to Abraham as killing or burning and then records God's rescue.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed reading in the focus command's humbled obedience.
Allows the redirection of dependence to specify the practical good asserted in the focus.
Supplies the denied capacity to own and dispose of what the people need.
Supplies allotted provision as the concrete object whose true source reorganizes allegiance.
Turns recognition of the true source into an active search directed toward God.
Makes gratitude to the benefactor the answering motion after provision and worship.
Closes the dependency circuit with return to the one from whom provision is sought.
Reinforces provision as sustaining food that creatures need not themselves carry because God supplies it.

changed_reading.after: Transfer practical dependence from provisionless cultic objects to God, and answer received provision with worship and gratitude before the return.
changed_reading.before: Worship God because that devotion is religiously better.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation denies the worshiped objects any ownership of provision, then links seeking from God, worship, gratitude, and return. The focus command reallocates dependence as well as ritual attention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lack of ownership, provision, directed seeking, gratitude, and return; I infer that attributed livelihood creates or redirects allegiance. A live alternative is that provision is only an argument for cultic worship, not a description of economic dependence itself.
structural_cues: 29:17 is the immediate explanation after the focus and coordinates provision-seeking, worship, gratitude, and return.
29:60-62 repeat that creatures do not carry their provision and that God apportions it expansively or narrowly.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the concrete collective Abraham addresses.
Makes shared obedience the axis on which that collective can be reorganized.
Contributes deliberate adoption and acquisition to the making of the people's cultic arrangement.
Identifies affection as the present social payoff binding the idol-users.
Locates that affection as a connective relation running between members.
Reverses the connective bond into hostile distancing under final accountability.

changed_reading.after: He asks a people held together by cultic affection to become a differently constituted community before that affection turns against them.
changed_reading.before: Abraham tells an already constituted people to change its object of worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people have adopted idols as a bond of affection among themselves, but that bond reverses into mutual repudiation and expulsion. Abraham's address to his people competes with an idol-mediated social architecture, seeking a community whose cohesion can survive accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies idol adoption, inter-personal affection, and later reversal; I infer that cult sustains group cohesion and that Abraham proposes a rival basis of belonging. A live alternative is that affection is merely the motive for idol use, not a full social structure.
structural_cues: 29:24 shows the addressed people enforcing their order through a kill-or-burn response.
29:25 names present affection between idol-users and its future reversal into mutual denial and cursing.
29:36 repeats the people-address plus worship command while joining it to public non-corruption.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in putting oneself into a guarded posture concerning God.
Anchors the focus claim that the protective good must be recognized.
Supplies the denied possibility of an alternate loving and helping patron outside God.
Frames substitute protectors as agents entrusted with care that cannot actually hold.
Supplies the web-making creature for the surah's material analogy of false protection.
Makes refuge and dwelling the concrete form in which claimed protection is evaluated.
Diagnoses the substitute shelter as structurally weak and unable to sustain reliance.
Echoes the focus condition of knowing at the point where false shelter is exposed.

changed_reading.after: Recognize that no substitute shelter can screen you from God, and take up the accountable alignment that alone makes guarding meaningful.
changed_reading.before: Guard yourselves through a general attitude of fear toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: No alternate patron can defeat accountability, and taking such patrons is compared to inhabiting the weakest house. The focus pairing of guarding oneself and knowing becomes discernment about protective architecture: one cannot evade God through substitutes, so protection concerning God requires exclusive alignment rather than a rival shelter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inescapability, absent substitute patronage, fragile shelter, and the repeated knowledge condition; I infer that these specify the protective logic of the focus command. A live alternative is that the focus verb means guarded fear of judgment without any shelter analogy.
structural_cues: 29:21-22 combine mercy and punishment with inability to escape or find another patron or helper.
29:41 repeats the knowledge condition while evaluating substitute patrons through the spider-house comparison.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the starting location in Abraham's inherited human collective.
Anchors the portable constant in obedient worship rather than place or kin.
Contributes movement from one abode to another as Abraham's response after rejection.
Supplies terrestrial space as the field across which worship can continue.
Opens that field beyond the constriction of a hostile local order.
Repeats servanthood and worship as the allegiance maintained across the opened terrain.

changed_reading.after: The allegiance offered to the people is not place-bound; when their order becomes coercive, it can be carried beyond them across God's broad earth.
changed_reading.before: The command asks Abraham's people to reform while remaining within their inherited social place.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the people answer coercively, Abraham departs toward his Lord; later, the breadth of God's earth grounds a renewed worship imperative. Allegiance is therefore portable across territory and may require leaving the social space named in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejection, Abraham's change of abode, broad earth, and renewed worship; I infer that spatial release enables fidelity to the focus command. A live alternative is that migration is only a later consequence and does not retroactively color the initial summons.
structural_cues: 29:24 gives the people's coercive answer, and 29:26 gives Abraham's migration toward his Lord.
29:56 grounds an exclusive worship command in the breadth of God's earth.

activation_trace.role: Anchors knowing in the branch of a distinguishing mark that directs a perceiver.
Makes Noah's deliverance a manifest mark available to later readers.
Requires sight or insight to notice how creation begins.
Turns travel into directed observation for apprehending the creative process.
Makes reasoning a restraint against missing the clear remnant left for a people.
Associates successful uptake of the surah's comparisons with those who genuinely know.

changed_reading.after: If they can read the historical, material, and created traces around them, they can verify the superiority claimed for worship and guarded allegiance.
changed_reading.before: If the hearers possess the relevant fact, they will agree that worship and guarding are better.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly turns rescues, remnants, creation, and parables into visible marks to be seen, inspected, restrained in mind, and known. The focus condition is thus not passive information but competence in reading traces that demonstrate why the paired commands are better.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained sequence of marks, seeing, observing, reasoning, and knowing; I infer that the focus conditional names this evidential practice. A live alternative is that it is a conventional admonitory conditional with no special method of knowing implied.
structural_cues: 29:15, 29:24, and 29:35 leave historical deliverance or destruction as signs.
29:19-20 move from seeing to travel and directed observation of creation.
29:41-43 place the spider comparison between a knowledge conditional and the claim that knowers grasp parables.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the claim of a beneficial alternative for the people.
Spans the two mentions of life and sharpens the claim that only one is fully living.
Marks the present life as the near or lower horizon against which benefit can be mismeasured.
Contributes displacement from what matters by absorption in something else.
Contributes action lacking a sound final purpose to the diagnosis of near-life priorities.
Supplies the later horizon in which the focus claim's comparative value is finally measured.
Repeats the focus's knowing condition precisely where the two scales of life are contrasted.

changed_reading.after: They are better on the scale of durable life and return, even when idol-based cohesion appears more useful in the near term.
changed_reading.before: The commands are better by an unspecified measure of benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing contrast repeats the knowledge condition while demoting near life to diversion and aimless play and identifying the later abode with actual living. The focus comparative is recalibrated by durability and ultimate return rather than immediate social convenience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated knowledge formula and an explicit contrast between near-life distraction and later-life reality; I infer that this contrast sets the scale for the focus word 'better.' A live alternative is that the focus comparison also includes immediate worldly welfare, especially provision and social order.
structural_cues: 29:25 locates idol-mediated affection in near life and shows it reversing on the day of rising.
29:57 places death before return, while 29:64 contrasts near life with the later abode and repeats the conditional of knowing.

activation_trace.role: Anchors prayer within the broader field of obedient and humbled worship.
Supplies the barrier logic that the later restraining practice makes concrete.
Contributes the specified ritual practice as a repeatable form of worship.
Contributes prayer as a binding devotional practice rather than a momentary assent.
Supplies the explicit checking and restraining action attributed to prayer.
Names conspicuously ugly conduct as one object against which the restraint works.
Names repudiated wrong as the second object checked by the practice.

changed_reading.after: Worship can be the repeated discipline through which guarding becomes behaviorally effective against transgression.
changed_reading.before: Worship and guarding are adjacent obligations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later prayer is a specified worship practice whose stated action is to restrain conspicuous indecency and repudiated wrong. The focus pairing of worship and guarding becomes operational: repeated devotion forms an internal brake against boundary-crossing conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet itself supplies prayer's restraining arrow; I infer that this specified practice exemplifies how the focus's worship command generates the guarding paired with it. remaining_uncertainties: The shelter model is analogical: the focus command concerns guarding oneself with respect to God and does not itself state that God is a shelter.
Migration may be only a consequence of the people's rejection rather than part of the initial command's semantics.
The roadmaking and people-standing readings are deliberately contained root resonances, not lexical translations.
The focus comparative may include immediate worldly benefit as well as the later-life scale emphasized by the surah's close.
strongest_changes: The paired commands became a transfer of dependence from provisionless cultic objects to God as giver, with seeking, gratitude, and return completing the circuit.
The addressed people emerged as a social formation held together by idol-mediated affection that can become coercive now and reverse under accountability.
Guarding and knowing were concretized by absent substitute patrons and the spider-house comparison as discernment about protection that can actually hold.
The repeated knowledge condition recalibrated what is 'better' by trace-reading and by the horizon of durable life rather than near-term convenience.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction linked the focus's compact sequence of saying, people, worship, guarding, good, and knowing to unusually concrete mechanisms: assay by fire, provision circuits, social bonding, fragile shelter, migration, disciplined restraint, visible signs, and path formation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Worship paired with a protective barrier.** و ق ي B001 is warding harm off with a protective barrier, and B002 is placing the self in protective caution. The imperatives worship/guard are followed by “better for you,” assigning protective function to the commanded orientation. I infer that worship erects a boundary against the false dependencies named next; taqwa reads as active self-positioning behind that boundary.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The spider-house in 29:41 makes the protective reading more precise: alternative patrons imitate a barrier while providing the weakest support. Taqwa is not generic fear but selection of the effective protection relation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Worship places the community under protective authority.** Lexical evidence: `ٱعْبُدُوا`, root `ع ب د`, `B003` (worship and submissive obedience); `ٱتَّقُوه`, root `و ق ي`, `B002` (placing the self in protective caution); and `ٱللَّه`, root `ء ل ه`, `B001` (the worshipped one). Structural cue: the two imperatives are joined; `29:17` then shows that alternative objects neither own nor allocate provision, and `29:22` denies their protection and aid. Assigned role: worship orders allegiance, while caution places the self behind the corresponding protective boundary. Abductive move: I infer from the imperative pair and later incapacity that obedience is practical relocation under the only effective authority. Reading change: worship is not only ritual address but a protective governance relation.

2. **“Better” names a knowable choice between provision systems.** Lexical evidence: `خَيْر`, root `خ ي ر`, `B003` (choosing or seeking the better option), and `تَعْلَمُون`, root `ع ل م`, `B001` (knowing as clear). Structural cue: `29:17` contrasts powerless idols with provision sought at God, while `29:19-20` call for reflective seeing of originated creation. Assigned role: knowledge discloses the superior option; `خير` makes that disclosure action-guiding. Abductive move: the packet does not explicitly call worship a provisioning choice; I infer it from the immediate contrast of owners, providers, and return. Reading change: “better for you” becomes a rationally inspectable reallocation of dependence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:41`, `29:60-62`):** The weakest shelter models failed guardianship, while creatures and servants receive provision under one allocator. Together they make the worship-caution pair operational: the better choice is the authority whose protection and provision actually bear their expected loads.

topics.reason: The rows give concrete formula parallels after commands (2:54, 4:25, 5:38, 24:60, 61:11).

topics.headline: local benefit against worldly distraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hold this better-benefit claim against the later contrast with worldly life as diversion (29:64).
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete surah contrast between this better claim and later worldly-life language (29:64).

topics.headline: valuation inside knowledge-framed address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the value claim framed between recalled prophet and tested knowledge.
topics.reason: The ayah opens with prophetic recall and closes with the knowledge condition, placing this predicate inside that movement.

topics.headline: tanwīn landing before benefit phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a small cadence on the valuation before the benefit phrase resumes.
topics.reason: The sound note is tied to the local indefinite ending and supports the evaluative pause.

words.gloss_range: benefactive prepositional element in the audience-benefit phrase, pointing the evaluation toward the addressees
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) in the benefit phrase makes the valuation personal: the command-complex is better for the very people being addressed. The suffixal audience thread in {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) ties the benefit back to Abraham's people, and the repeated lām mirrors the earlier speech-direction phrase so the ayah moves from address to advantage.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: to his people, speech recipient phrase

topics.headline: benefit attached to predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the better claim is not abstract; it is for the commanded audience.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the prepositional complement to the comparative predicate as the beneficiary phrase.

topics.headline: suffix routes benefit to Abraham's people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same addressees carried through command, benefit, and condition.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix points back to the commanded people and belongs to the repeated addressee thread.

topics.headline: from speech direction to benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier lām that sent speech to the people mirrored by a later lām that sends benefit to them.
topics.reason: The first lām marks recipient of speech and this later one marks beneficiary, preserving same form with changed local function.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle that makes the audience's knowledge a questioned condition on recognizing the benefit
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) turns the closing knowledge clause into a challenge. The particle does not presume that the people know; it makes knowing the condition under which the better-benefit claim becomes recognizable. The omitted answer sends the reader back to the prior valuation, so the audience must complete the logic: if they truly know, this is better for them.

topics.headline: uncertain conditional knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah tests whether the audience truly knows, instead of assuming it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a conditional protasis, and the CRITICAL rows contrast this particle with a more presumptive conditional.

topics.headline: suppressed conditional answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the logic loop back to the value claim instead of hearing a fully restated conclusion.
topics.reason: The conditional is attached to the prior nominal evaluation, allowing the answer to be recovered from it.

topics.headline: condition as epistemic challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees resistance exposed as a failure of knowledge without the accusation needing to be stated directly.
topics.reason: The conditional tail qualifies the benefit claim and frames the audience's knowledge as the decisive issue.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural state verb introducing the audience's established condition before the knowing verb
words.prose: {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) slows the closing condition into a state test. The audience is not asked whether they had one flash of information, but whether they are in the condition of knowing; being and knowing fuse into the close's state formula. The 2mp suffix keeps Abraham's people inside the verb and echoes the earlier addressee thread, while the root's being-field adds existential pressure and local construction remains the state verb plus imperfect knowledge complement.
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, forming, and statehood; here it forms a conditional state frame for knowledge

topics.headline: state verb plus imperfect knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the close as a test of established knowing, not a simple if-you-know tag.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following imperfect as predicate/complement of the state verb.

topics.headline: 2mp subject inside state verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same audience carried into the knowledge test as the grammatical subject.
topics.reason: The suffix encodes second-person plural subject agreement and echoes the prior addressee thread.

topics.headline: being field questions condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the condition as a question about what state the people are in, while broader creation or formation branches are not locally selected.
topics.reason: The k-w-n field supports statehood pressure, narrowed by the local auxiliary/state construction.

topics.headline: being and knowing pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees being and knowing fused into a state formula at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence supports the state-of-knowledge pairing in the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperfect knowing, objectless and ongoing, closing the ayah as an epistemic test
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}) is the final word, so the ayah closes on epistemic accountability. As the complement of {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}), it names the content of the audience's state; as an objectless active imperfect, it tests ongoing operative knowing rather than a single specified fact or a passive claim that instruction was merely delivered. The root-field also carries the boundary handoff from the previous ayah's worlds language (29:15): universal sign-scope becomes personal knowing at the close of this address. That human knowing remains tied to the divine object named earlier, while the local verb itself remains the addressees' act of knowing.
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, teaching, marking, and world/domain associations through related forms; here the verb selects active human knowing without an overt object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: you were or are in a state

topics.headline: imperfect complement of state verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowing is the content of the audience's state, not an independent jussive command.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the verb as the predicate/complement governed by {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}).

topics.headline: objectless operative knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge tested as a capacity or condition, not narrowed to one unstated object.
topics.reason: The verb appears without an overt object, and translation support warns against supplying a narrowed object not licensed by the Arabic.

topics.headline: benefit answerable to knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the persuasion as epistemic: knowing is what should disclose the better option (2:184, 16:95, 29:16).
topics.reason: The conditional knowledge formula ties recognition of benefit to cognition, with concrete formula parallels (2:184, 16:95, 29:16).

topics.headline: worlds-to-knowing handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous ayah's world-sign language (29:15) become this ayah's personal knowledge test, while the local word remains the verb of knowing.
topics.reason: The ʿ-l-m family connection to the previous ayah's {{ar:لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ}} ({{tr:lil-ʿālamīna}}) is a valid boundary echo (29:15), narrowed so it does not replace the local verbal sense.

topics.headline: ongoing active plural knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices active ongoing knowing by the same addressees, not a passive claim that instruction was merely delivered to them.
topics.reason: The Form I imperfect active 2mp form encodes ongoing action and subject agreement.

topics.headline: human knowing near divine object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps human knowledge tied to the divine object named earlier, while the local verb itself remains human knowing.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence pressure around ʿ-l-m and ʾ-l-h survives as relational framing, not as a new object for the verb.

topics.headline: ayah closes on knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end not on command or benefit but on accountable knowing.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah and carries the closing long ending, making knowledge the structural endpoint.
